name: io.github.akhilesh-chandewar/eco-policy-mcp
title: Eco Policy MCP
description: MCP server for Indian finance data: mutual-fund NAVs (AMFI), GST and income-tax calculators (FY 2026-27), RBI policy rates and NSE market data. Works with any MCP client over stdio or streamable-HTTP; every response carries provenance (source + as-of timestamp).
